definitions.explanation: The perspective from which one views or judges things; one's role or situation.
The circumstances or position one finds oneself in, especially regarding responsibility or social role.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立場|たちば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand in someone's position)
- {立場|たちば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to consider one's position)
- {立場|たちば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to be in an awkward position)
- {立場|たちば}⟦{上|じょう}→上：noentry⟧ (due to one's position)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立場|たちば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to put oneself in someone else's shoes)
- {立場|たちば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (for positions to be reversed)
- {立場|たちば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take advantage of one's position)

- {立場|たちば}: Position, standpoint (personal perspective)
- ⟦{観点|かんてん}→観点：05582_kanten⟧: Viewpoint (more analytical)
- ⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧: Status, rank (social hierarchy)
